finding_A_one_percent_low_definition.before_defect: Computed `onePercentLowFps = 1000.0 / p99FrameTimeMs` (at N=180, p99 selected index 178 such that 10-entity 1%-low 397.91 FPS exceeded average 307.84 FPS!).
finding_A_one_percent_low_definition.after_fix: Sorts all N=180 frame durations descending, averages the slowest `ceil(180 * 0.01) = 2` frames, and computes `1000.0 / slowestOnePercentMeanMs`. Reports `p99FrameTimeMs` separately.

finding_B_cpu_submission_vs_gpu_frame_ti.before_defect: Labeled isolated `Stopwatch` around `Camera.Render()` without distinguishing CPU render-submission throughput from full GPU completion, standalone pacing, or OBS capture.
finding_B_cpu_submission_vs_gpu_frame_ti.after_fix: Explicit `timingScope = cpu_camera_render_submission_editor_batchmode`, queries `FrameTimingManager.IsFeatureEnabled()` (`gpuFrameTimingStatus = NOT_MEASURED_IN_EDITOR_BATCHMODE`), and marks standalone 15-min & OBS capture `NOT_EXECUTED`.

finding_C_managed_gc_allocation.before_defect: Used `GC.GetTotalMemory(false)` before/after loop (net heap delta can be 0 even if per-frame allocations were collected).
finding_C_managed_gc_allocation.after_fix: Uses `GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread()` cumulative monotonic thread allocation counter + `ProfilerRecorder(ProfilerCategory.Memory, 'GC Allocated In Frame')`, reporting `netHeapDeltaBytes` separately.

finding_D_inconsistent_report_numbers_an.before_defect: ART-008 README cited stale `261.66 FPS` while `performance_report.json` had `1016.38 FPS`; GPU render files were named `unity_d3d11_*.png` on a `Direct3D12` run; `drawCalls = 0` reported instead of `NOT_MEASURED`.
finding_D_inconsistent_report_numbers_an.after_fix: All Markdown & QA summaries single-sourced from `performance_report.json`; stale `unity_d3d11_*.png` removed and replaced by `unity_d3d12_*.png`; `drawCalls = -1` (`drawCallsStatus = NOT_MEASURED`).
